item.title: Expertise in Custom Medical Cable Assemblies and Precision Plastic Components
item.description:
Comprehensive Capabilities in Medical Cable Assemblies and Plastic Components
#

Cambus Corporation has been dedicated to providing engineering and manufacturing solutions for custom medical cable assemblies and plastic components since 1997. Our expertise encompasses a wide range of services, from OEM/ODM design to precision plastic injection molding, cable assembly, and wire harness solutions tailored for the medical industry and beyond.
